tongue.definition: The soft part inside your mouth that you can move to help you eat and speak.
tongue.source: Manual defining-sense proposals from retained fruit rejection evidence, 2026-09-28; teacher replies adapted by agent review in evals/review/level_2_taste_senses/review.json

taste.definition: What you feel with your tongue when food or drink touches it, apart from how hot, cold, hard or soft it is.
taste.source: Manual defining-sense proposals from retained fruit rejection evidence, 2026-09-28; teacher replies adapted by agent review in evals/review/level_2_taste_senses/review.json
